summary: Tested 11 assertions: 8 passed, 1 failed (VAL-ENTITIES-009: API failure shows blank page instead of error UI), 2 blocked (VAL-ENTITIES-005/006: no TYPE relations in data). Key findings: (1) API error handling is broken - shows blank page instead of error message with retry, (2) Type filtering cannot be tested without typed entities in the database.
